title: Towards Agents That Know When They Don't Know: Uncertainty as a Control Signal for Structured Reasoning
authors: Josefa Lia Stoisser; Marc Boubnovski Martell; Lawrence Phillips; Gianluca Mazzoni; Lea Mørch Harder; Philip Torr; Jesper Ferkinghoff-Borg; Kaspar Martens; Julien Fauqueur
why_relevant: Proposes using retrieval uncertainty (entropy over table-selection rollouts) and summary uncertainty as control signals for abstention, filtering, and RL training in a structured-data agent, directly relevant to calibration/abstention in retrieval-augmented settings.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on multi-table biomedical summarization rather than standard text RAG; relevance is via analogy of retrieval uncertainty and abstention control.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control (abstention and uncertainty-guided retrieval)
